reviews.text: I couldn’t say enough about the training they are helping me with.  I have a 6.5 yr old leash reactive bulldog, because she’s been attacked twice on a leash.  I was at wits end.  We have only gone through 4 sessions and I am already seeing so many changes and improvements.  We just signed up for our second package of 4!  I am getting back to enjoying my dog, and enjoying walking her without fear of her behavior!

We're disappointed to see your review – especially since we just got off the phone with you. We understand that you had a scheduling mix-up on your calendar last week that caused you to miss your private training appointment.

Unfortunately, when a private training session is missed without notice, the trainer and training space have already been reserved, and that time cannot be offered to another client. For that reason, missed appointments are not eligible for a credit or refund. We strive to apply this policy consistently and fairly to all clients.

We understand that unexpected situations can arise, and we always encourage clients to reach out as soon as possible if they're unable to attend a scheduled appointment. While we can't always make exceptions, we do our best to be flexible whenever circumstances allow.

As we discussed, we'd love the opportunity to continue working with you and Bella. We're happy to help get you back on the schedule since you still have remaining sessions, and support your training goals moving forward.

Zoom Room has been such a great place for our pup! She gets so excited when we walk up to the door. The facility itself is incredibly clean and the instructors are AMAZING! Coco has been so helpful and patient as we navigate being first-time puppy owners.

So I went to this place when they had first opened. They had offered a discount price a one time entry, if you wanted to bring your dog. I think 2 years has passed since I've been there but I will never go again, and I don't recommend it. I have four dogs, all well trained but I had only brought one that day, my dog Mia who loves every dog she meets, and she's a 59lb pitty mix. She lives with her three siblings, and on the first floor is my daughter with three dogs under 15 pounds.  At this place, there was a lot of smaller dogs, but of course, there was larger poodles, retrievers that were even bigger than her. My dog was kept separated when they were doing the agility activities and placed in a corner because she was crying, she wanted to be around the other dogs which supposedly isn't really allowed but people were doing it, but mine wasn't allowed of course i'm guessing because she's a pitty. I'm a rescue mom, I've had her since she was eight weeks old and she's the sweetest dog I know. Funny when we made our way out of there because my husband was extremely angry on how our dog was treated, there was a large poodle, like standard size, which are about double my Mia's size and it growled at her, but that was okay to them and I can say I'm extremely disappointed in this place. My girl loves agility and was treated disgustingly. I can say the only good thing I got from there was a harness and I remember one member of the staff was nice. When we got outside, the good thing is not everyone treats pittys bad as there was a man with a tiny puppy, a 5 month old shitzu which was probably my dog's head size, and he let his dog play with my girl outside. I wish I would have took pictures and videos but I was just too angry at the time.
A great place for the whole family to go, and there's no entrance fee! 🥳🥳🥳 …

I cannot recommend Zoom Room and all their exceptional trainers enough! My mini Aussie is very energetic. He is a fast learner, but is very stubborn and mischievous. I started bringing him to calm down classes and then obedience. I wanted to bond more with him and build his confidence (and mine too!). We are both still a work in progress, but in a few months, he has made so much progress! We have so much fun at Pup-lates and learning agility. Zoom room didn't train my dog, they trained me how to be a safe space for my dog to feel confident and strong! I love bonding with my boy and seeing how much fun we both have at classes! I can't thank Lori, Coco, and all the staff here enough! If you're thinking about joining, just do it! It is definitely worth the time, energy, and money to feel confident with your pup!

Outstanding first session with Lori and Cocoa at Zoom Room! They were kind, patient, and incredibly effective. We learned great strategies and exercises for our SKG that we could apply right away—our dog learned sit, stay, and down in the first half hour! Skip the online searches and come here. Highly recommend this location!
